# `FluxRegistrar::register_event_handler`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-ABI">ABI</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **ABI v4** (`src/plugins/abi.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Registers one named plugin event handler for the requested event kind.

## Signature

```rust
fn register_event_handler (& mut self , event_kind : FluxEventKind , handler_name : & str ,) -> Result < () , FluxStatus >
```

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/fluxregistrar-register-event-handler.md`](../../examples/methods/fluxregistrar-register-event-handler.md)_

```rust
fn register_mouse_handler(registrar: &mut FluxRegistrar) -> FluxStatus {
    match registrar.register_event_handler(FluxEventKind::MouseDownCell, "onMouseDownCell") {
        Ok(()) => FluxStatus::OK,
        Err(status) => status,
    }
}
```
